mapper.sql: w.id, w.org_id AS orgId, w.name, w.slug, CASE WHEN w.lifecycle_state = 'active' AND o.lifecycle_state = 'active' THEN 'active' ELSE 'tearing_down' END AS lifecycleState
mapper.select: SELECT FROM workspace w JOIN organization o ON o.id = w.org_id WHERE w.org_id = #{orgId} AND w.id = #{workspaceId}
SELECT FROM organization o JOIN workspace w ON w.org_id = o.id WHERE o.id = #{orgId} AND w.id = #{workspaceId} AND o.lifecycle_state = 'active' AND w.lifecycle_state = 'active' FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM organization o JOIN workspace w ON w.org_id = o.id WHERE o.id = #{orgId} AND w.id = #{workspaceId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, name, slug, lifecycle_state AS lifecycleState FROM organization WHERE id = #{orgId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM org_member WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND org_role = 'owner' )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_operation_lease (org_id, workspace_id, lease_kind, lease_token) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{workspaceId}, #{leaseKind}, #{leaseToken})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM organization WHERE id = #{orgId} AND lifecycle_state = 'tearing_down'
